● Pair stays in the second chair.github.com/makefunstuff/pairing-buddy
Pairing buddy is the person in the second chair.
It sits beside you in Neovim,
and speaks up only when it matters.
It never touches your files,
unless you hand it the wheel.
A test is red,
and you start fixing the wrong file.
Pair reads the code first,
then says it right under your line:
the cause is elsewhere.
Alt J jumps there.
Save, and it runs your tests.
Your fix broke a queue test?
Pair says why, and Alt Y takes its fix.
Or hand it the wheel with Pair drive.
You watch it type, it tests your unsaved buffer,
and one undo takes it all away.
Notes in the margin.
A first slice from a blank page.
A ledger of everything it did, and a morning pick-up.
Any model, local or cloud.
Pairing buddy:
the person in the second chair.
